newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Evening up seen ahead of Cattl-on Feed report. Ideas on cash also mixed.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Jump in index supportive to May but backs may show further price resistance.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.150 to up 0.150 cent. Cash seen steady to lower but pork cutout up and futures discount to index.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 1.000 cent. Carryover from limit gains Thursday, light kills and higher product.
